description: Five distinct clearance check runs with exact raw-log bytes and result hashes: four passes and the retained failed protection run. Also preserves exact copies of start/result/available-provenance receipts and final v2 preview artifacts. The original ten-run archive is not rewritten.
scopeAndLimitations: Generated evidence packaging only. No tests, build, preview or gate executed. Credential-pattern scan plus manual inspection found no secret values; variable names and runtime randomBytes generation in preview source are not credentials. Stored process snapshots remain sampled, not continuous provenance. Preview serves the production client through actual pageGate/static middleware with synthetic disabled APIs, not full production composition or live Auth/SQL/commerce.

decode.log: const entry=archive.logs.find(x=>x.job===job); const bytes=Buffer.from(entry.bytesBase64,'base64'); require exact byteLength and SHA256===entry.sha256===entry.receiptLogSha256; writeFileSync(newAbsolutePath,bytes,{flag:'wx'}).
decode.artifact: Use archive.artifacts.find(x=>x.filename===filename); decode base64 and verify byteLength/SHA256 before direct byte write. Avoid shell text redirection, which can alter bytes.
decode.collector: Decode archive.collector.bytesBase64 into a new .mjs file and verify SHA256. Regeneration needs the original source artifacts alongside it and a repository cwd; it verifies and retains byte-identical existing receipts, refuses differing receipts, and refuses an existing archive.

logs.processProvenance: No provenance snapshot file exists; not inferred

artifacts.purpose: Distinct final preview artifact; original preview artifacts remain unchanged
